messages:
Sam: Quick question for the group  should the Console show an explicit "preview" vs "enforced" state for automatic fallback policies? We've seen users confused when the policy flips but nothing is paged.
Priya: Yes. We need 3 states: preview, soft-enforce, hard-enforce. Preview = no downstream routing change, only telemetry + suggested actions. soft-enforce = route % of traffic to fallback, no SLA alerts. hard-enforce = full cutover + alerts.
Jorge: For soft-enforce we should surface expected quota impact. If fallback uses cheaper models, tokens saved look great but can spike qps so quota math matters. show estimated tokens/s and estimated cost delta.
Lina: UX: small pill at top of route page: "Fallback: preview" with tooltip: "preview runs do not alter routing; they simulate decision logic." Add an "Apply" dropdown to promote to soft/hard.
Omar: Ops: add an acknowledge flow. When someone promotes to hard-enforce, require an operator to confirm and add a short comment. That creates an audit event with operator id + timestamp.
Sam: Also require role gating: only users with rollout:promote can move to hard. Preview and soft can be self-serve.
Priya: Good. For telemetry, emit events: fallback.preview.report, fallback.soft.estimate, fallback.enforce.event. Payload should include route, policy_id, predicted_delta:{tokens, latency}, decision_sample_id.
Jorge: Can we include a small simulation engine: when in preview, compute a 1 hour projected error reduction and token delta. show both median and 95th CI. Might reduce panic.
Lina: Microcopy: avoid language "failure". Use "protective routing". For preview state use greenish neutral color so it's not alarming.
Omar: Pager integration: only fire PagerBot for hard-enforce and only if SLA breach predicted > x% or raw errors > threshold. Soft-enforce should not trigger pager. Also add a checkbox "notify on promotion" per team.
Sam: Auditability: the UI should surface a compact timeline for each rollout: timestamp, who promoted, sampling rates, decision ids. Allow CSV export of sampled requests used for the preview.
Priya: Data retention concerns: keep preview samples for 14 days by default and soft-enforce persisted samples for 30 days. Hard-enforce persisted traces 90 days. Configurable per org.
Jorge: Re: quotas: if fallback switches to a larger model (rare) we should show simulated quota burn and require an override. automatic block if predicted quota > available_quota.
Lina: Add a "simulate promotion" button that runs the replay engine on last N sampled requests and shows side-by-side outputs and token usage. UI shows a diff heatmap for output divergence.
Omar: Security: sanitized request/response only. Mask PII and keep redact rules in a centralized service.
Sam: Could we add a small confidence score for the fallback decision so customers know if it's a conservative flip vs aggressive? e.g., confidence: 0.35.
Priya: Yep. Expose decision_reason and confidence. Also expose the signals used (p95 latency, 5xx rate, queue depth).
PagerBot: PagerBot: Note: test alert suppressed for preview mode.
Sam: Next actions: Lina + Priya to wireframe the three-state pill + promote flow; Jorge to spec the quota estimator + simulation metrics; Omar to list retention & RBAC defaults. I'll draft a short RFC for copy and audit event schema.
Lina: will do wireframes by EOD.
Priya: will draft telemetry schema.
Jorge: will start quota estimator PR.
Omar: will document RBAC and retention knobs.
Sam: thanks everyone.
